title: d/t/run-ocft: skip iscsi test gracefully when kernel lacks iscsi_target_mod (LP: #2170272)
description: d/t/run-ocft: skip iscsi test gracefully when kernel lacks iscsi_target_mod (LP: #2170272)
commit_message: d/t/run-ocft: skip iscsi test gracefully when kernel lacks iscsi_target_mod (LP: #2170272)
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index c208018..2ccb979 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,10 @@
+resource-agents (1:4.7.0-1ubuntu7.5) jammy; urgency=medium
+
+  * d/t/run-ocft: skip iscsi test gracefully when kernel lacks
+    iscsi_target_mod (LP: #2170272)
+
+ -- Zhang Hua <joshua.zhang@canonical.com>  Fri, 09 Oct 2026 12:00:04 +0800
+
 resource-agents (1:4.7.0-1ubuntu7.4) jammy; urgency=medium
 
   * d/p/docker-29-cli.patch: fix image existence check for docker >= 29
diff --git a/debian/tests/run-ocft b/debian/tests/run-ocft
index f820fce..8242f3c 100755
--- a/debian/tests/run-ocft
+++ b/debian/tests/run-ocft
@@ -4,6 +4,16 @@ set -e
 
 AGENT=$1
 
+if [ "$AGENT" = "iscsi" ]; then
+  # The iscsi agent test relies on targetcli and the kernel LIO iSCSI target subsystem.
+  # If the running kernel lacks iscsi_target_mod (e.g. linux-image-kvm where CONFIG_ISCSI_TARGET is not set),
+  # skip the test gracefully.
+  if ! modprobe -q iscsi_target_mod 2>/dev/null; then
+    echo "SKIP: iscsi_target_mod module is not available in running kernel $(uname -r)"
+    exit 0
+  fi
+fi
+
 cleanup () {
   ocft clean $AGENT
 }
